doc.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Thanks and closing
summary: Brown thanks Palmieri and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, I want to thank you for saying all that you did today, sharing with us your life story, your philosophy, your heart. I want to say on behalf of the Smithsonian and the NEA, thank you, Mr. Eddie Palmieri for all the joy you’ve brought to our lives...
Thank you, Anthony. Thank you very much.
...for making some of the greatest music that’s ever been made.
Thank you. Again, thank you. [END OF CD #3, END OF CONVERSATION} Transcribed by Ted Panken
